description_en: Updates the basic information of a flow based on the flow code
description_zh: 根据流程编码更新流程基础信息
kebab_example: aliyun cams update-chat-flow --title '测试流程' --remark '流程备注' --flow-code 9ccc4100000000000000000000000000 --biz-code ALICOM_OPAAS --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateChatFlow

parameters.help_en: The flow code. View the flow code in the Flow Builder (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)
parameters.help_zh: 流程编码。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码
parameters.name: flow_code

parameters.help_en: The business tenant code. Default value: ALICOM_OPAAS
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en: The business extension information. Default value: an empty collection
parameters.help_zh: 业务扩展信息，默认为一个空集合
